dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately falcate trailing edge characterized by a concave curvature with multiple irregular serrations and notches along the lower two-thirds of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse pixel radius, lacking sharp terminal tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Extremely shallow angular steepness; the anterior margin follows a long, low-gradient incline relative to the dorsal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Low profile with a high width-to-height ratio; the pixel width of the fin base is significantly greater than the vertical distance from the base to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several distinct, irregular notches (mechanical tissue loss) are visible along the trailing edge, including one deep V-shaped indentation near the vertical midpoint and multiple smaller nicks toward the posterior insertion point.
